The user wants me to fix the datepicker so that when a user types a date and presses Tab, the datepicker closes. The issue is that the datepicker doesn't hide when the input loses focus via keyboard navigation (Tab).

2. The event listeners registration in the constructor

```javascript
  hide() {
    if (this.inline) {
      return;
    }
    this.picker.hide();
    this.picker.update().changeView(this.config.startView).render();
  }
```
